description: The file defines the ContactManager class responsible for managing contact synchronization, including adding, updating, deleting, and querying contacts from Android's contacts content provider. It handles operations such as ensuring sample groups exist, batching contact changes, updating contact status messages, and managing sync flags.

classes.name: ContactManager
classes.description: A class that provides static methods to manage contact synchronization, including creation, updates, deletions, and querying of contact data within the Android contacts provider.

classes.name: ContactManager.EditorQuery
classes.description: A static inner class defining constants for querying contact editing data.

classes.name: ContactManager.ProfileQuery
classes.description: A static inner class defining constants for querying profile data based on user ID.

classes.name: ContactManager.UserIdQuery
classes.description: A static inner class defining constants for querying raw contact IDs based on server contact ID.

classes.name: ContactManager.DirtyQuery
classes.description: A static inner class holding constants for querying contacts that are marked as dirty or deleted, needing synchronization.

classes.name: ContactManager.DataQuery
classes.description: A static inner class specifying fields for querying detailed contact data, such as name, phones, email, avatar.

classes.name: ContactManager.ContactQuery
classes.description: A static inner class specifying basic contact info query parameters.

methods.name: ensureSampleGroupExists
methods.description: Ensures that a sample contact group with a predefined name exists for the given account, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: updateContacts
methods.description: Synchronizes a list of raw contacts with the device's contacts database, updating existing or adding new contacts, batching operations for performance.

methods.name: getDirtyContacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts marked as 'dirty' or 'deleted' needing sync by querying the contacts provider.

methods.name: updateStatusMessages
methods.description: Updates the status messages for a list of contacts, typically after adding new contacts.

methods.name: clearSyncFlags
methods.description: Resets sync-related flags on contacts after a sync operation, deleting or clearing dirty flags appropriately.

methods.name: addContact
methods.description: Adds a new contact to the device's contacts provider, adding name, phones, email, group membership, and avatar.

methods.name: updateContact
methods.description: Updates an existing contact's data, including name, phone numbers, email, avatar, server id, and profile creation if needed.

methods.name: setAccountContactsVisibility
methods.description: Sets whether contacts associated with a specific account are visible or hidden in the contacts list.

methods.name: getRawContact
methods.description: Constructs a RawContact object from the local contacts database by querying contact data.

methods.name: updateContactStatus
methods.description: Updates the IM status message associated with a contact.

methods.name: clearDirtyFlag
methods.description: Clears the 'dirty' flag on a contact to indicate it is synchronized.

methods.name: deleteContact
methods.description: Deletes a contact record from the contacts provider based on raw contact ID.

methods.name: lookupRawContact
methods.description: Finds the raw contact ID associated with a server contact ID.

methods.name: lookupProfile
methods.description: Retrieves the profile data row ID for a given server user ID.
